entities.summary: Countess Jutta von Sponheim, also called Blessed Jutta of Disibodenberg was an anchoress and teacher at the monastery of Disbodenberg who helped raise Hildegard von Bingen. Jutta was the youngest of four daughters of Count Stephen of Sponheim, born into affluent surroundings in what is currently the Rhineland-Palatinate. Jutta was also related to Marchioness Richardis von Stade, the mother of Hartwig, Archbishop of Bremen and of Richardis, who was intimate friends with Hildegard.
